market_outlook.short_term: Volatile and risk-off. Oil above $100 and diesel at $6 drive inflation fears, pressuring equities. Fed hawkish pivot likely. Geopolitical headlines (Iran, Saudi) create daily volatility. AI names may pull back on governance concerns but capex data supports medium-term bid. Expect 5-8% equity volatility in coming weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (TSMC, Oracle, Google) provides 12-18 month earnings visibility. Defense spending structural. Energy transition (solar storage problem, First Solar) creates selective opportunities. Consumer value shift is multi-year. Higher rates compress multiples but favor cash-generative businesses. Geopolitical fragmentation reshapes supply chains permanently.
